'''Defense Force Station Ifpe'a''' was a [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==Description==
Shaped like an inverted cone, the station spanned about 1,000 meters from point to base. It contained at least one docking bay, and sported capacity for dozens of hyperspace capable [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].<ref name="CBHP" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Sev'eere'nuruodo]] of the [[Nuruodo family]] met [[Nuru Kungurama|Kung'urama'nuruodo]], an ambassador of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], onboard. During their meeting, Ifpe'a was attacked by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] fleet under the command of overseer [[Umbrag]]. While the Aristocra and the ambassador escaped with the ''[[Hasty Harpy]]'', the Chiss station could not resist and was captured by Separatist forces.

At the behest of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], Umbrag dispatched his armada back to [[Skako/Legends|Skako]], leaving the overseer's personal Metalorn Yacht as the captive installation's sole defense. The lone vessel was easily overpowered by the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Gang]] when they returned with the ''Harpy'', forcing Umbrag to retreat. Ifpe'a was reclaimed by a flotilla of Chiss warships immediately following the skirmish.
